name: Neumarkt (Italy)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, red and white, charged with the municipal arms of Neumarkt (a crescent and a cross, counterchanged red and white) beneath the inscription MARKTGEMEINDE NEUMARKT / COMUNE DI EGNA in black.
history: Municipal flag of Neumarkt, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Neumarkt arms — crescent and cross counterchanged red and white
inscription MARKTGEMEINDE NEUMARKT / COMUNE DI EGNA above the arms
